title: One working document per list
description:
The assembler and editors work on one document per issue. For a list set to `story`, it is the issue Story on the board all period (Ryan's living issue), and the email Delivery renders an approved version of it; after the send it is published to the archive. For a list set to `delivery`, it is the Delivery's own text versions and there is no archive page. Slots, pins and removed-item records use the same block marks in both, so one assembler serves weekly and daily.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A weekly issue is a Story on the board during the week.
- A daily summary makes no Story and no archive page.
- Pins and removals behave the same in both.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- list-working-document.feature: a `story` list creates one issue Story per period; a `delivery` list creates none; a pinned slot survives a refill in both; a removed item is never re-added in both.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Newsletters and subscriptions: weekly, daily and every new item. Slice code N10 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
